newsitem.title: USA: Most U.S. debt futures end slightly lower.
newsitem.headline: Most U.S. debt futures end slightly lower.

text.p: Most U.S. debt futures ended slightly lower, but traders left open the possibility for a stronger recovery on Wednesday.
March T-bonds traded below Monday's high of 114-19/32, and ended at 114-12/32, under Monday's close of 114-14/32.
"I'll hold off on deciding whether or not we've slayed the bullish trend, but it's hard to envision an environment where prices start falling off from here," one futures trader said.
Most traders said the U.S. November Producer Price Index (PPI) could lead interest rate futures higher.
"The numbers could improve sentiment," a trader said.
Overall PPI is seen rising 0.3 percent, versus up 0.4 percent in October, and the core rate is expected to increase 0.2 percent, from October's decline of 0.3 percent.
Traders said the 0.8-percent increase in U.S. Redbook retail sales for the first week of fiscal December versus November had little affect on the market.
However, after the data were released, one U.S. institution sold about 2,000 March bonds, a trader said.
Large offers at the 114-12/32 to 114-13/32 area kept the contract from testing the daily high of 114-14/32. Overnight, the contract ran into strong resistance at 114-22/32.
"This market has not recovered enough, but the quietly lower close sets the market up for higher prices on Wednesday," William Bohnsack, president of W.H. Bohnsack & Co, said.
Bohnsack said he would become intermediate-term bearish if the market is unable to recover on Wednesday. He said the market was due for a downturn in December after six months of gains.
He said March bonds would have to close above 115-03/32 on a weekly basis to reverse the market's long-term bearish signals.
Bond futures had been caught between the uptrend of 1987 and the downtrend from 1993, but had followed the 1993 after falling sharply last Thursday, Bohnsack said.

At the end of pit trade, March T-bonds were off 02/32 at 114-12/32, 10-year notes were off 01/32 at 110-16/32, March Eurodollars were unchanged at 94.48, June Eurodollars were down one basis point at 94.37 and munibonds were flat at 116-12/32.
